_source: overhead 2/Gui/StatusBox.vb renderStatus, Gui/HeroScreen.vb renderheroScreen, Gui/Messages.vb, Fonts.vb, Root.Write, RECONSTRUCTION 6.1 and 13. Positions are pixels of the 640 x 480 screen the original drew on (the window stretched it); Write drew text left and top aligned at the point, in the colour (a, r, g, b).

clock._note: renderStatus writes the day period's name at (5, iHeight - 70) and the time at (5, iHeight - 57) in fontCalisto, (128, 255, 255, 0).

heroScreen._note: renderheroScreen writes the date line at (iWidth - 250, 25) and the time line (time, two spaces, period) at (iWidth - 250, 45) in fontCalisto, (128, 255, 255, 0). The screen itself (Page Up, menu.png) comes with the interface story (U.OVW-US-A20).

statusBox._note: Gui/StatusBox.vb renderStatus (status_box.png is loaded but its draw is commented out, so only the text shows): at (statOffsetX, statOffsetY) = (x, y), the leader's name at +name, written '  Name  ' in white; then 'HP n', 'MP n' and 'AP n' at +value and '  / max' at +maximum, each row rowSpacing lower, in (255, 255 - r, 255, 255 - b) of the world light (r, g, b), so green by day. In team mode the other heroes follow at +teamSpacing each, their names in (255, 255 - r, 255, b).

bars._note: Gui/HealthBar.vb, ManaBar.vb and StaminaBar.vb: the leader's bars at the bottom left, width x height, the fill drawn first and the bar over it; the fill quad is width x value / max wide (rounded to a whole pixel, as VB's Integer assignment did, never below 0) with the whole fill picture on it. The mana bar reuses health_bar.png.

rest._note: Engine.showRestText: while the leader is laid and kneeling, 'Rest for n hour?' (n = 1) or 'Rest for n hours?' is written at (iWidth / 2 - 100, iHeight / 2 - 20) in fontArialNarrow24, (255, 255, 255, 255). The HUD is not dimmed by a sleep's fade.

examine._note: Gui/ExamineBox.vb renderExamine: in examine mode, with the cursor over an unpicked pickup, examine.png stretched over 328 x 175 at (292, 112), the pickup's world picture 32 x 32 (itemIconSize) at +(15, 10), then in fontArial white: the name at +(50, 20), the effect at +(20, 45), 'Description:' and the description below it at +(20, 75), 'Weight: ' at +(20, 125) and 'Value: ' with strCurrency '$' at +(20, 145).

inventory._note: Inventory.vb: inventory.png (332 x 385) drawn over 345 x 400 at (iWidth - 345 - 12, iHeight - 400 - 50); icon slots of 32 px from the panel + (8, 8), 32 apart, ten to a row (the wrap test is iconCols > 32 * 9), rows 40 apart, 101 of them; item_cursor.png on the selected icon and swap_cursor.png on the icon marked for a swap. In fontArial: 'Weight: n / limit' (FormatNumber(x, 1)) at +(345 - 120, 400 - 22) and 'Gold: n' at +(12, 400 - 22) in (255, 128, 255, 128); with a stack selected its name (with ' x n' over one) at +(12, 400 - 110) and its weight at +(345 - 30, 400 - 110) in that green, its effect at +(12, 400 - 92) and description at +(12, 400 - 66) in (255, 0, 255, 255), and '$' and its value at +(345 - 24 - 6 per character, 400 - 44) in the green. Every stack over one writes its count in fontAmount at its icon + (14, 24), or + (12, 24) past 9, in (255, 0, 255, 255).

quickBar._note: QuickBar.vb: quick_bar.png (470 x 47) drawn over 400 x 36 at (iWidth - 400 - 2, iHeight - 36 - 2) while bQuickBar is on (Q); the first ten stacks' icons, 32 px, at the bar + (1 + 40 n, 0), drawn before the bar, each count over one in fontAmount at the icon + (16, 18), or + (15, 18) past 9.

inventoryButton._note: Gui/InventoryBtn.vb and Cursor2D.rendercursor2D: a 28 x 28 square at (18, 104) showing inventory_Open while the panel is open and inventory_Closed otherwise (32 x 30 pictures stretched to it); the left button toggles the panel while the virtual mouse is across its width and between its top - 10 and its bottom - 12.

burdened._note: StatusBox.renderStatus: while the leader is burdened, 'You are overburdened' at (centerScreen.X - 75, centerScreen.Y) in fontCalisto, in the status box's (255, 255 - r, 255, 255 - b) of the world light.

target._note: HeroSelect.renderHeroSelect: while an item's target is being chosen, select_hero.png on the chosen hero's quad (heroSize square at its position), and renderText's '.' (scale 0.02) and its name (0.007) at (x + heroSize / 2 + 0.005, y - heroSize / 2 + 0.1), in the world's light.

messages._note: Messages.vb: up to maxMessages waiting (a message added to a full queue replaces the last); the next is shown at the screen centre, x less 6 / 2 per character, once the last shown is more than 'spacing' pixels below the centre or gone; each shown message loses 'fade' alpha and drops 'drift' pixels a tick, starting at alpha 255, and is gone at 0. The period announcements use fontArialNarrow24 in white.
